abilene_arrival.description: Freight into Abilene. The song got there first, but the load needed a truck.

air_ready.description: You built air like a pro. Even the fastest rig on the interstate needs its PSI.

all_regions.description: You've hauled in every region on the map. That list of towns is finally long enough.

all_terrain_route.description: Flats, hills, and a real mountain grade on one route. The freight never noticed.

all_upgrades.description: Every upgrade in the catalog, installed. A fully loaded tractor still turns heads.

amarillo_arrival.description: Into Amarillo, load on the dock by daybreak. No pony, but a fine Panhandle dawn.

appalachia_delivery.description: Into Appalachian coal and ridge country, on roads that bend like fiddle tunes.

appreciation_week.description: A load during Truck Driver Appreciation Week. Doughnuts at the window and a thank-you from dispatch.

april_first.description: A delivery on April 1. The load was real, and the joke was on nobody.

authority_active.description: Your own authority is active. Your freight, your rates, your risk, and all the upside.

bakersfield_arrival.description: Freight on the dock in Bakersfield. Your air brakes kept the twang's beat.

baton_rouge_arrival.description: Into Baton Rouge with a paycheck coming. Beats busted flat with a harmonica.

big_payday.description: One load over 4,000 dollars gross. Big money, on the right side of the law.

birmingham_morning.description: Birmingham before the coffee kicked in. You'd been rolling since before the birds.

bobtail_done.description: A bobtail move, no trailer. Turning around takes a lot less room without the box.

brake_smoke.description: You cooked the brakes until they started to fade. Next hill, pick a lower gear.

break_taken.description: Your 30-minute break, taken. One more cup, and your knees said thanks.

chattanooga_arrival.description: Freight into Chattanooga, quicker than any old train on a schedule.

christmas_delivery.description: A load signed for on Christmas Day. Somewhere, dinner went on without you.

clean_delivery.description: Delivered without a new dent. The rig's still pretty enough for a billboard.

coast_to_coast.description: One run across most of a continent, salt air to salt air.

coffee_regular.description: Twenty-five breaks taken right. The sitting down did more than the coffee.

construction_zone.description: You crept through the cones like each one had a lawyer.

dakota_delivery.description: A load into the Dakotas, where the horizon talks and the wind argues back.

dawn_run.description: You pulled out before first light. Early starts pay off in yawns and bonuses.

deadline_squeaker.description: On time with almost nothing to spare. The dock tore up the late note.

deep_repair.description: You brought the truck back from 75 percent damage or worse. Only one way to go from there.

desert_summer.description: A summer delivery into the desert Southwest, where the door handle bites.

detention_paid.description: A shipper held you past free time, and the carrier billed them. The clock worked for you.

detroit_run.description: A load out of Detroit. Home keeps calling, but freight pays better.

doubles_load.description: Your first set of doubles, delivered whole. The rear trailer wandered; the mirrors told the truth.

dropped_the_bad_one.description: You hauled a written-up trailer across the country and left it in the receiver's yard. You checked the lights at every stop.

eastbound_delivery.description: A load hauled east and on the dock. Eastbound, hammer down, and nobody waited.

eighty_eight_mph.description: 88 miles per hour in a loaded truck. No time travel, just a brief lapse in judgment.

el_paso_arrival.description: Freight into El Paso. The old ballads end in heartbreak; yours ended with a signature.

every_fleet_tier.description: You've driven every tier of the fleet, trainer rig to first pick. The good iron was worth the wait.

farm_load.description: Farm freight where it was needed. Somewhere a rancher checked the sky and said much obliged.

fifteen_states.description: Freight delivered in 15 states. The glovebox is mostly toll receipts.

fifty_deliveries.description: Fifty deliveries. The board knows your handle, and the windshield knows every bug.

fifty_five_mph.description: Not the mid-90s anymore, whatever Jim Kitchen told you in Trucker. Wrong game. Floor it and hit 88.

fifty_thousand_miles.description: Fifty thousand miles. The long ribbon of road won't let you walk away.

first_day.description: First load, first dock, and the air built to cut-out. Day one is in the books.

first_delivery.description: Your first load, signed for and gone. Clean paperwork, no fanfare.

first_delivery_drop.description: Your first drop at the receiver. Leave the loaded trailer, hook an empty, and roll.

first_dispatch.description: Your first load off the board. Just a handle, a load number, and somewhere to be, good buddy.

first_drop_hook.description: Your first drop and hook. You were rolling before a dock could find you a door.

first_late.description: Your first late delivery. The bonus walked, and you learned how much cushion a deadline has.

first_on_time.description: You beat the deadline to the dock. Dispatch only reads the timestamp anyway.

first_pickup.description: Cargo's aboard and sealed. Eighteen wheels don't roll themselves to the dock.

first_rest_stop.description: Your first rest stop. The romance lasted as long as the vending machine's stare.

first_ticket.description: Your first speeding ticket, paid at the roadside. Dispatch wasn't even surprised.

first_upgrade.description: Your first upgrade, a small taste of souped-up confidence.

five_deliveries.description: Five deliveries. That itch to roll finally has a stat line.

five_hundred_mile_run.description: One dispatch over a thousand miles. The weather changed its mind twice.

five_tractors.description: Five different tractors under you. You know which spares pull and which just make noise.

fleet_flagship.description: The fleet flagship, with the big bunk. The yard hands you the keys first.

fleet_upgrade.description: Dispatch gave you a newer tractor, fueled and washed. Seniority smells like fresh upholstery.

fort_worth_arrival.description: A load into Fort Worth. The stockyards went showbiz; the freight stayed honest.

four_seasons.description: Deliveries in all four seasons. You've seen the road's whole wardrobe.

friday_thirteenth.description: Delivered on Friday the 13th without a scratch. Bad luck took the day off.

fuel_fumes.description: You made the dock on fumes and prayer. Hope is not a fuel plan.

garage_repair.description: Fixed right at a real garage. An honest bill, and the truck earns its keep again.

georgia_arrival.description: Midnight freight into Georgia. No first-class ticket, just a sleeper and a thermos.

grueling_clean.description: Over 1,200 miles, on time and spotless. No run comes easy, except yours.

gulf_coast_by_two.description: On the Mississippi Gulf Coast by two o'clock. Shrimp boats, salt air, signed bills.

half_million_earned.description: Half a million dollars earned over your career. Not easy money, but it spends.

hazard_avoided.description: You slowed in time for a road hazard. Your brake pedal had other plans.

hazmat_load.description: Your first placarded load, no incidents. The paperwork rode shotgun. Careful pays.

heavy_haul_load.description: Your first heavy-haul load. Every gear change felt like moving a legend.

heavy_hauler.description: You bought the heavy hauler. The hills got nervous, and so did the fuel bill.

high_value_load.description: Your first high-value load, seals intact. It rode quiet and never stopped for souvenirs.

home_return.description: With 10 deliveries behind you, you brought a load home. The streets shrank; the welcome didn't.

hooked_a_bad_one.description: You hooked a yard trailer and found a defect on the walk-around. Now it's yours.

houston_arrival.description: Freight into Houston, sprawling enough for four rush hours. Every mile counted.

hundred_deliveries.description: A hundred deliveries, load after load, until the number got serious.

hundred_fifty_cities.description: A hundred fifty cities delivered. The far side of the map is feeling left out.

hundred_grand.description: A hundred thousand dollars banked. Slow as a Cadillac a piece at a time, but legal.

hundred_k_miles.description: A hundred thousand miles. The road owns most of you now, but not all of you today.

inspection.description: An inspection with your paperwork in order and your axle weights behaving.

jackson_arrival.description: A load into Jackson. Tennessee or Mississippi, this badge takes either.

jake_only_descent.description: Two miles of real downgrade without touching the service brake. The engine brake held it all.

jam_and_cones.description: Cones and a traffic jam on one trip. The truck became a waiting room with mud flaps.

jersey_delivery.description: You delivered in New Jersey and lived to merge again. Jughandles and all.

kansas_city_arrival.description: Freight into Kansas City. Burnt ends, wide boulevards, and no help backing into the dock.

kentucky_delivery.description: A load signed for in Kentucky. The grass is blue; the money was green.

laredo_arrival.description: Freight in Laredo, right on the border. Strictly business, and everybody stayed cheerful.

lcv_load.description: Your first turnpike doubles run. Two long trailers, and every lane change planned half a mile out.

level_fifteen.description: Career level 15. The owner-operator plan is taped to the sun visor now.

level_five.description: Career level 5. Dispatch quit double-checking, and you can turn down a load without a lecture.

level_ten.description: Career level 10, senior driver. Better freight, and new hires think you know every dock.

level_thirty.description: Career level 30, the top rung. The road ahead is yours to choose.

level_three.description: Career level 3. Another new town, but this chapter pays better.

level_twenty_five.description: Career level 25. You qualify for your own operating authority. In freight, that's arriving.

long_day_run.description: One dispatch longer than a day on the trip clock. The last hundred miles felt personal.

long_haul.description: One loaded haul over 900 miles. Long enough for the seat cushion to earn seniority.

low_visibility.description: Fog thick enough to bend a banjo string, and you never lost the road.

lubbock_arrival.description: Out of Lubbock with a load, the hometown shrinking in the mirror.

manual_driver.description: You ran in manual. Every clean shift sounds cool until the grade changes key.

max_gross_load.description: A load near the legal weight limit, and the scale house waved it through.

max_level.description: Career level 20. Same docks, same diner pie, but the pages turn easier now.

memphis_arrival.description: Freight in Memphis, where the river hauls nearly as much as the highway.

meridian_classmate.description: Lou turned up as your co-driver, back from Meridian Freight Lines with a story nobody quite believes.

midnight_delivery.description: Freight delivered between midnight and first light. Whatever rode along signed nothing.

montana_delivery.description: Freight in Montana, where the radio runs out and the sky doesn't.

month_on_road.description: A full month on the career clock. Docks, diners, and dawn starts, and you want more.

mountain_clean.description: A mountain grade, and the freight came down clean. The brakes politely declined to fail.

multi_leg_haul.description: One dispatch, four corridors, run nose to tail.

multi_state.description: Three states on one route. The map had to clear its throat.

muskogee_arrival.description: A load into Muskogee, Oklahoma. Clean paperwork counts as manners here.

nashville_delivery.description: A load in Nashville, where songwriters wait years. Your freight broke through on the first try.

never_fought_the_law.description: Fifty deliveries without a ticket. No story to tell, and that's the point.

new_england_delivery.description: Into northern New England: narrow bridges, frost heaves, and town names that fight the GPS.

new_orleans_arrival.description: A load into New Orleans, a little behind the beat. The coffee fixed it.

new_year_run.description: Midnight on New Year's, between two towns. They counted down; you counted mile markers.

night_shift_regular.description: Ten loads delivered in the small hours. Empty lanes and surprised receivers.

no_toll_long.description: Over 300 loaded miles without a toll. This run never got the memo.

norcal_giants.description: Up in far Northern California, where the redwoods make a trailer feel small.

one_for_the_road.description: After midnight, on fumes, in the rain, and still on time. Nothing went wrong fast enough to matter.

owner_operator_buyin.description: You leased on as an owner-operator. Bigger revenue, your bills, your calls.

perfect_streak.description: Five straight on time, undamaged, and ticket-free. Quiet on the CB, good on the paycheck.

phoenix_arrival.description: Freight delivered in Phoenix. The desert never did cool off.

pnw_delivery.description: Freight in the Pacific Northwest, where the evergreens crowd the shoulder and the rain sets its own schedule.

port_load.description: Your first container off the port. Your card got you through the gate.

predictive_crest.description: Cruise read the hill ahead, banked a little speed, and carried it over the top.

quarter_million_bank.description: 250,000 dollars banked. The teller quit counting out loud.

radio_dial_wanderer.description: Twenty-five stations found and left behind. You're reading the country off the dial.

radio_faded_out.description: You rode a station to the edge of its reach, until the hill got in the way.

radio_fringe_catch.description: You caught a station far outside its range, up where the air is thin.

radio_three_states.description: One station carried you across three states. The transmitter's still trying.

rain_driver.description: Through the rain, wipers keeping time and your following distance keeping order.

reefer_load.description: Your first reefer load, temperature steady. The trailer ran cold; your mood didn't.

refused_the_trailer.description: You found what was wrong with a trailer and refused it. Thirty minutes for the swap.

rep_ninety.description: Reputation 90 or better. Stroll the truck stop like you own the coffee machine.

return_trip.description: You hauled the next load right back where you started. This week the horizon ran a shuttle.

roadside_fix.description: Broke down, waited out roadside help, and finished the run. The show rolls on.

route66_run.description: A haul between two old Mother Road towns. The neon's faded, but you still got your kicks.

route_refuel.description: You topped off before it got dramatic, then kept on truckin'.

sacramento_arrival.description: Freight into Sacramento. You heard a train whistle near Folsom and kept rolling, free.

saginaw_arrival.description: A delivery into Saginaw, where the bay wind finds every gap in the cab.

san_antonio_arrival.description: Freight in San Antonio. The river walks; your trailer rolled.

scale_regular.description: Five inspections over your career. You could clear the scale house in your sleep.

second_ticket.description: Two speeding tickets in one run. The first was a lesson; the second was a choice.

securement_load.description: Your first flatbed load, every chain still tight. You checked within the first 50 miles, by the book.

self_paid_course.description: You paid for an endorsement course yourself. Ambition has tuition, and you paid cash.

seventy_five_cities.description: Seventy-five cities have signed for your freight, and the coffee's bad in every one.

sixteen_tons.description: Sixteen tons in one load. And what did you get? A sore back and a dispatcher asking for more.

sixty_nine_mph.description: Exactly 69 miles per hour for a full mile. No significance. You know what you did.

sleep_before_exhaustion.description: You bunked down before fatigue took the wheel. This time you listened.

slept_on_route.description: Ten hours in the bunk, and you woke up legal. Unglamorous, and heroic.

southbound_run.description: A delivery that ran hard south, toward warmer air and somebody waiting on freight.

speed_limit_saint.description: A whole run without one speeding strike. You thought hard about the insurance.

spotless_long.description: Over 300 miles, on time, with no damage, strikes, or tickets. The paperwork is your only trace.

state_crossing.description: Your first state line with freight aboard, kept between the lines.

storm_driving.description: Through a real thunderstorm, and the trailer stayed behind you where it belongs.

tank_load.description: Your first tanker load, delivered. The surge tried to drive the whole way. You didn't let it.

ten_deliveries.description: Ten deliveries. A long, strange road, and the receipts pile up faster than the stories.

ten_four_day.description: A load settled on the fourth of October, ten-four day. A white knight started it, and the whole channel said it back.

ten_thousand_miles.description: Ten thousand miles. The white-line fever is just the job now.

texas_triangle.description: Both ends of the load inside the Texas Triangle. This week the whole map was one state.

thirty_states.description: Thirty states delivered. Most folks need a camper and a lifetime to see that much.

thousand_miles.description: A thousand miles. The white-line fever's in your blood, and the bugs are on the glass.

three_regions.description: You've worked three freight regions. Dispatch still mispronounces the next one.

three_trucks.description: Three tractors with your name on the titles. The insurance folder calls it a fleet.

thrifty_run.description: A whole run at better than 8 miles per gallon. Light foot, right gear.

toll_paid.description: One beep at the toll, and the carrier ate it. Accounting took the wheel.

top_reputation.description: Your reputation pinned the meter. The channel knows your handle, and dispatch takes your word.

traffic_slowing.description: Heavy traffic, and you kept a sane following distance. You let the jam breathe.

trainer_ride_along.description: Ray, who ran your training class, rode one load with you to see how you turned out.

true_north_run.description: A delivery that ran hard north. You found a bearing, and it had a dock at the end.

tulsa_arrival.description: Into Tulsa right on time. The dock was glad to see you.

twenty_five_cities.description: Deliveries in 25 cities. The atlas falls open to the right page now.

twenty_five_deliveries.description: Twenty-five deliveries, somewhere between rookie and veteran, with more road than most.

twenty_five_grand.description: 25,000 dollars banked, a load at a time. Slower than a Cadillac in a lunchbox, but legal.

two_hundred_deliveries.description: Two hundred deliveries. That's a body of work.

vegas_arrival.description: A load into Las Vegas. You only gambled on the merge, and the house lost.

virginia_line.description: Freight on a Virginia dock, across a county line worth singing about.

waco_survivor.description: Freight into Waco without a scratch. Whatever the songs say, you kept your health.

weather_collector.description: You've driven under every sky in the forecast. None of it lasted; you did.

westbound_delivery.description: A load hauled west, chasing the sun down to the dock.

wichita_arrival.description: A load signed for in Wichita. A lineman waved; you were watching the wind.

winslow_arrival.description: A load into Winslow, Arizona. You're the second most photographed thing on the corner.

winter_delivery.description: A load delivered in the dead of winter, heater roaring. You kept rolling.

winter_or_wind.description: Snow or crosswind, the trailer stayed in line and out of the headlines.

wyoming_delivery.description: A delivery in Wyoming. No traffic, just wind, antelope, and the odd legend.

great_lakes_training.description: A practical training-fleet start. Stop pay is better on short loads, and dispatch leans toward shorter training work with a little more deadline room. Equipment and routine costs stay carrier-paid. At level 4 with full dispatch trust, Business status lets you move to another carrier.
great_lakes_training.dispatch: more short training loads, more appointment slack
great_lakes_training.name: Great Lakes Training Transport

northstar.description: A balanced company-driver path. The carrier assigns and maintains the tractor, pays fuel and routine repairs, and offers steady wage math without a sharp specialty.
northstar.name: Northstar Freight Lines

prairie_link.description: A mile-focused company start. The per-mile wage floor is higher, but stop pay is lower, so it favors steady regional mileage over very short hops. Dispatch leans toward same-region grain and bulk work. The carrier still assigns and maintains the tractor.
prairie_link.dispatch: more same-region lanes, more longer lanes
prairie_link.name: Prairie Link Regional

summit_value.description: A performance-sensitive company start. Good on-time runs pay better, but the guaranteed floor is smaller. Dispatch leans toward longer and higher-value lanes. The carrier still supplies equipment, authority, insurance, fuel, and repairs.
summit_value.name: Summit Value Logistics
